summary: A 24-wide pale limestone slab (white_terracotta) set narrow-end east toward the plaza and rising to a flat 8-wide crown at y232. Its north and south flanks step back in 2-block ledges (212→218→222→224→228→232), and at the east end they cascade down (196→153→110→41), following the lidar roof map. Every face is fluted with 1-wide piers and recessed dark window strips; it has Top of the Rock glass-parapet decks, a red "GE" sign, a floodlit crown, the WISDOM entrance on the plaza, and a 16-storey Sixth Avenue wing in the same pier language.
